technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term bullish structure (EMA 50/200) and positive squeeze setup, but weak momentum (RSI, OBV), price below all key moving averages, three black crows pattern, and lack of volume confirmation make this a poor swing entry at current levels.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 50 days adds timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No composite congressional signal; mixed junior-level trades 125+ days old; Fear index (43) presents contrarian opportunity but insufficient conviction from political insiders or recent news to confirm.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (172.2) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 50 days present binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 50/200 bullish crossover and positive squeeze setup provide long-term structural support, with price near support level (134.75) offering defined risk entry for patient traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all key moving averages, zero volume confirmation (OBV false), RSI weakness (38.56/43.33), three black crows pattern, VIX crisis levels, inverted yield curve, and earnings binary risk in 50 days create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh structural bullish setup.

decision.entry_rationale: While EMA 50/200 bullish structure and price at support (134.75) offer structural appeal, the confluence of weak momentum (RSI 38-43, OBV false), zero volume confirmation, three black crows pattern, and VIX crisis levels create an asymmetric risk/reward unfavorable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: VIX at crisis levels (172.2) combined with inverted yield curve and NFP event in 2 days creates macro volatility that could trigger sharp reversal below support, invalidating the structural setup before momentum can confirm.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish lean; technical weakness, fundamental void, and macro headwinds converge
